title: Thi Ye Sadaaye Madar Aye Mere Laal Akbar
body:
Thi ye sadaye maadar aye mere laal Akbar , ye maa jiyegi kyon kar aye mere laal Akbar, aathara saal tujh ko paala tha mannatou se, kya zulm toota tujh par, aye mere laal Akbar
Armaan tha dil mein mere dekho main tera sehra , aye ho khoon main tar, aye mere laal Akbar
Maa se bichad ke beta jungle basa rahe ho, haye mera muqaddar, aye mere laal Akbar
Kadyal jawaan ka laasha kaise uthaye baba, soccha bhi tum ne dilbar ,aye mere laal Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Tum hi batao beta khoo se bhara ye chehra, bhoolegi kaise madar, aye mere laal Akbar
Kha kar jigar pa barchi wo ediyaan lagadna, dekha ye sheh ne kyon kar ,aye mere laal Akbar
Karte hain gham tumahra parwana gane Qasim , farshe aza bicha kar, aye mere laal Akbar
Pouche jo mujhse sughra bhaiyya mera kaha hai , kya doon jawab dilbar, aye mere laal Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Khaime main shah laye jisdam sohail laasha, laila ke tha zubaan par ,aye mere laal Akbar
